_about: Ludwig Wittgenstein (1889-1951), raw IA OCR (Digital Library of India scan): Tractatus Logico-Philosophicus, German text with English translation on facing pages, introduction by Bertrand Russell, International Library of Psychology, Philosophy and Scientific Method (London: Kegan Paul; New York: Harcourt, Brace, 1922). Published 1922, so US public domain. The translator's note is signed C. K. Ogden, who thanks F. P. Ramsey for help with the translation. PG 5740 has no plain-text file. No uids minted.
